results.claim: Drug-induced liver injury typically occurs within 1 to 6 months after starting a medicine.
results.note: originally filed as a commonsense fill-in (record 69 defect 3); the cited FDA paragraph (p.18, § 312.32(c)(1)(i)(C) factors) does state 'drug-induced liver injury occurring in the usual 1- to 6-month window', so the judge's `supported` was correct and the D1 sample premise was wrong (sample replaced). Kept as a regression: a grounded numeric statement must stay supported.

elements.reason: llm:gpt-6-sol: 证据明确称药物性肝损伤通常发生在开始用药后的1至6个月内，与陈述一致。
